test_reconnect: test that a gRPC channel reconnects after the server is stopped and restarted on the same address
run_ReconnectTest: run the ReconnectTest unittest class to verify gRPC channel reconnection behavior after server restart
review_handle_unary_unary: review the _handle_unary_unary RPC handler function that returns a fixed binary response
refactor_ReconnectTest: refactor the ReconnectTest class to use a configurable sleep interval instead of hardcoded 5.1 seconds
summarize_reconnect_test: summarize the gRPC channel reconnection test that starts a server, stops it, waits, restarts, and verifies the client reconnects
